follow-up time: 6 weeks after hospitalization following caesarean delivery
cohort: Women admitted for ECS and their newborns
finding: Elective caesarean section at Mulago Hospital is associated with significant neonatal and maternal morbidity, particularly for infants born with a birth weight less than 2500 g or more than 4000 g, delivered at a gestational age less than or equal to 38 weeks, and when general anesthesia is used.
mod_finding: Elective caesarean section was associated with significant neonatal morbidity.
